thought: She started making ice cream at home during the 2020 lockdown. By 2026, her business crossed Rs 30 lakh a year.
support: Geeta Devi, of Hathsar village in Sheohar district, Bihar, joined a Jeevika self-help group in 2017 and began selling milk and handmade fans before turning to ice cream during the 2020 Covid lockdown, when her husband Vijay Kumar was stranded away from home for work. Her brand, Sagar Ice Cream, now makes vanilla, butterscotch, mango, apple and strawberry flavours, sold through 18 local vendors, with a turnover of Rs 30-35 lakh a year supporting roughly 20-25 families. All five of her children are now in private school. A lockdown improvisation became a livelihood - for her family, and for everyone she now employs.
